# Ochre Sea Star

The ochre sea star eats mussels and can grow a new arm.[^tide-pools] Unlike birds that
hunt by [wading](/wiki/concepts/wading.md), it moves slowly over the rocks.[^tide-pools]
At low tide, birds [wade][wading-page] past it and the [Grey Heron][] looks for
fish.[^tide-pools]
